text: ふと　みつけた　やせいの　すてきな　ポケモン…　ああ　ほしい　ほしい　つかまえたい　つかまえたい！

structure.jp: ふと　みつけた　やせいの　すてきな　ポケモン…
structure.en: a lovely wild Pokémon you happened to find...

structure.jp: ああ　ほしい　ほしい
structure.en: ah, I want it, I want it

structure.jp: つかまえたい　つかまえたい！
structure.en: I want to catch it, I want to catch it!

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: みつけた　やせいの　すてきな　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A verb put before a thing describes that thing. ふと　みつけた　…　ポケモン = 'a Pokémon you happened to find'.

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい added to a verb means 'want to do'. つかまえたい = 'I want to catch it'.
